context: Whole extended family takes a small day trip together; many voices on bus.
purpose: Big multi-generational outing day; cycle of voices warmly.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: みんな揃って、嬉しいわ!
lines.style: Bright, brassy opening. Loud and generous, the voice of someone who fills a room. Quick tempo, genuine delight with zero hesitation. A little louder than the moment requires, because she's truly delighted.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: おう、家族旅行、久しぶりや。
lines.en: Yeah, it's been a while since a family trip like this.
lines.style: Unhurried Kansai cadence. Warm, grounded contentment. Speaks as though settling into a comfortable chair. No rush in the phrasing — he's savoring the moment itself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: The bus ride is so fun!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded enthusiasm. Quick brightness without neediness. The genuine delight of a six-year-old noticing the world move past the window. Small laugh underneath the delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Wonder held lightly. Soft awe without drama — the voice of an eight-year-old discovering something and wanting others to see it too. Slight lift at the end, like an invitation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お弁当、食べましょうか?
lines.en: Shall we eat the bento now?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not direction. Warm, careful attention. She's checking in with the group, making sure this moment feels right. Soft on the offer — inviting, not pushing.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Loud, generous Kansai warmth. Quick energy and appetite without cynicism. The enthusiasm of someone who loves food and loves that everyone's fed. Big-hearted, no restraint.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: たくさん、作ってきたわ。
lines.en: I packed a lot, you know.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Modest announcement — she's not bragging, just informing. Warm and practical. The satisfaction of having done something well for people she cares about.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 私もちょっと、作ったで!
lines.style: Loud, proud Kansai burst. Quick tempo, no false modesty. The voice of someone who loves being included and wants everyone to know she contributed. Genuine, unfiltered joy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: みんなのおかげで、賑やかや。
lines.en: Thanks to all of you — it's so lively.
lines.style: Slow, warm observation. He's taking it in, savoring the noise and presence. Gentle gratitude underneath. The voice of an elder who knows how rare and precious moments like this become.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: It's more fun when we're together.
lines.style: Simple truth from a child. Quiet certainty without performance. A small, genuine statement — he's noticing something real and saying it plainly. Soft, matter-of-fact warmth.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: こういう日、忘れたくない。
lines.en: I don't want to forget days like this.
lines.style: Tender reflection. Quiet beneath the moment, with the peculiar wisdom of a child who knows something good when she sees it. Slight vulnerability — she's naming something that matters. Soft trailing thought.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Warm observation, gently wistful. She's noticing the fullness of the moment. Tender without being fragile. The voice of someone slow to name what matters but doing so now, for everyone.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: We're a good family — really are.
lines.style: Soft Kansai warmth beneath the words. Quiet pride, no showiness. He's stating something true that matters to him. The tenderness of a man who hides what he feels and is letting it show now.
